name: opencode-magnific
description: OpenCode / magpie plugin: Magnific image and video generation (Flux, Nano Banana, Seedream, Kling, Veo, Seedance, WAN, …) as agent tools and native magpie image and video models
author: hubo

summary.en: Magnific image and video generation with a Magnific API key: 20 native image and video models (Mystic, Nano Banana, Flux, Veo, Kling, Seedance, WAN, …) and tools that reach all 140 endpoints from every agent.
summary.zh: 用 Magnific API key 接入生图、生视频：20 个原生生图/视频模型（Mystic、Nano Banana、Flux、Veo、Kling、Seedance、WAN 等），外加每个 agent 都能调用、覆盖全部 140 个端点的工具。
